title: Down-weighting is the principled choice
prompt:
# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
16:9 full-slide PowerPoint image, English, no visible slide number.

## Use Case
text-localization; make two precise content edits to the existing slide while preserving its established layout and design.

## Input Images
- Image 1: existing slide 13 edit target. Preserve its title, three stacked translucent panels, icon system, palette, typography, spacing, background grids and curves, and all unchanged text.
- Image 2: slide 15 general-sans typography reference. Match its modern sans-serif family, weights, and projection-safe clarity.
- Image 3: approved slide 31 style reference. Match palette, texture, and polish only.

## Exact Visible Text and Order
Title: "Down-weighting is the principled choice"
Panel 1: "Cronbach (1951) — Reduce error variance, don’t remove observations."
Panel 2: "Huber (1964) — Down-weighting over deletion for stability."
Panel 3: "Marsh & Roche (1997) — Don’t throw the validity baby out."

## Primary Request
Reorder the panels so the authors appear Cronbach first, Huber second, and Marsh & Roche third. Replace the Huber panel text with the exact revised sentence above. Keep everything else visually unchanged. Retain the existing accent progression across the three panels and move each author’s associated panel treatment with that author.

## Constraints
- Render every exact text string verbatim, including years, ampersand, em dashes, apostrophes, capitalization, and terminal periods.
- The order must be Cronbach → Huber → Marsh & Roche.
- The Huber statement must read exactly: "Huber (1964) — Down-weighting over deletion for stability."
- Add no other text.
- Preserve the existing title, panel layout, icon language, palette, background, and hierarchy.
- No watermark and no visible slide number.
- No overlaps or truncation.

input_images.fidelity: preserve all visual design and unchanged content; change only panel order and Huber text
match typeface family, weights, and readability only
match style only; do not copy layout or content

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: approved slide 31 prompt and user-directed edits
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: view_image for local edit target and typography/style references; built-in conversation image context
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Use this same built-in image_gen backend; return a blocker if unavailable.
